throughline.zh: 無人機採購清查揭示晶片來源查核進度，聯發科提出 AI ASIC 市占預測，主計總處公布半導體設備進口年增，分別對應政策、設計市場與製造設備供應鏈。
throughline.en: Drone procurement reviews, MediaTek's AI ASIC share outlook and reported semiconductor equipment import growth describe policy enforcement, chip-design forecasts and manufacturing supply-chain activity.

title.zh: 內政部清查 3 機關共 32 架無人機採購，30 架尚未交貨
title.en: Interior Ministry reviews 32 drones across three agencies; 30 remain undelivered

summary.zh: 台灣內政部 10 月 31 日公告，因無人機使用中國製晶片的疑慮，初步清查涉及 3 個機關共 32 架亞拓科技相關無人機。其中國家公園署及中央警察大學各採購 1 架，移民署今年決標的 30 架合約價值新台幣 275 萬元，尚未交貨；晶片來源與個案違約責任仍待確認。
summary.en: Taiwan's Ministry of the Interior said on October 31 it was reviewing 32 drones linked to Align Corp. across three agencies amid allegations involving Chinese-made chips. Two agencies each purchased one drone, while a NT$2.75 million contract for 30 drones at the National Immigration Agency remains undelivered; component origin and any breach remain under review.

text.zh: 無人機使用飛控、通訊、電源管理及影像處理等晶片與零組件，政府採購規格涉及原產地文件與零組件追溯。內政部所稱非紅供應鏈規範已用於政府採購，但單一案件調查仍需確認實際元件來源。
text.en: Drone assemblies contain flight-control, communications, power-management and imaging chips. Government procurement involves component traceability and origin restrictions; individual suspected parts still require examination.

text.zh: 內政部表示 2025 年國家公園署及中央警察大學各買 1 架；2026 年移民署透過公開招標向速源科技採購 30 架，合約 275 萬元。後者原擬交付亞拓產品，但尚未交貨，主管機關已表示將依契約要求符合來源條件。
text.en: The ministry reported one drone purchased each by the National Park Service and Central Police University in 2025. In 2026 the National Immigration Agency awarded a public tender for 30 drones worth NT$2.75 million to Suyuan Technology; the planned Align-made drones have not been delivered and the ministry says contract origin requirements will be enforced.

text.zh: 32 架涵蓋已購與尚未交貨數量，不表示 32 架均已查驗不合格。檢方偵查中的晶片產地、責任歸屬、合約後續及是否求償均尚無最終認定。
text.en: The 32 figure combines past purchases and undelivered contract items; it does not mean all 32 were inspected and failed. Chip origin, legal responsibility, contract disposition and damages remain unsettled.

title.zh: 追蹤：聯發科估 2027 年 AI 加速器 ASIC 市占約 20%
title.en: Follow-up: MediaTek projects roughly 20% of AI accelerator ASIC market in 2027

summary.zh: 中央社 10 月 31 日進一步報導聯發科 10 月 30 日法說內容，執行長蔡力行預估 2027 年 AI 加速器 ASIC 市占率約 20%。他此前已說明首款 ASIC 自 9 月出貨、2027 年營收估 160 億美元；市場占比和收入均屬管理階層預測，尚無已完成的全市場出貨比較。
summary.en: On October 31, CNA reported additional detail from MediaTek's October 30 earnings briefing: CEO Rick Tsai forecasts around a 20% share of the AI accelerator ASIC market in 2027. Initial September shipments are reported, while market share and US$16 billion 2027 revenue remain company forecasts without verified marketwide shipment data.

text.zh: AI ASIC 設計涉及晶圓代工、先進封裝、測試、HBM 與伺服器組裝。市占率預測依特定市場定義，無法直接用作整體半導體或 GPU 市占。
text.en: AI ASIC designs connect foundries, advanced packaging, testing, HBM and servers. The forecast concerns a defined AI accelerator ASIC market, not all semiconductors or GPUs.

text.zh: 10 月 31 日報導增加公司對 2027 年約 20% 市占的預期。10 月 30 日已公布的首款 ASIC 初步出貨、第四季 25 億美元及明年 160 億美元營收預期，均作為明確標日期的背景。
text.en: The October 31 report adds management's approximate 20% market-share outlook for 2027. Already reported September initial shipments, Q4 US$2.5B guidance and 2027 US$16B guidance remain dated background.

text.zh: 未揭露預測使用的市占分母、客戶出貨明細、已認列收入與未來 ASIC 實際供貨量；報導為媒體轉述法說。
text.en: The forecast market denominator, customer shipments, recognized ASIC revenue and future delivery volumes remain undisclosed; reporting is based on the earnings call.

title.zh: 台灣第三季 GDP 年增概估 14.36%，半導體設備進口年增 35.66%
title.en: Taiwan Q3 GDP advance estimate grows 14.36% YoY; semiconductor equipment imports rise 35.66%

summary.zh: 主計總處 10 月 30 日公布台灣第三季實質 GDP 概估年增 14.36%，較 8 月預測上修 2.94 個百分點。中央社引述主計總處指出，第三季以新台幣衡量的資本設備進口年增 58.5%，其中半導體設備進口年增 35.66%；GDP 概估及設備進口金額變化均不等於新增晶圓產能已完成裝機。
summary.en: On October 30, Taiwan's DGBAS released a Q3 real GDP advance estimate of 14.36% YoY, 2.94 percentage points above its August forecast. CNA reported capital-equipment imports up 58.5% in Taiwan-dollar terms, including semiconductor equipment imports up 35.66%; import growth does not establish commissioned wafer capacity.

text.zh: 半導體設備進口與晶圓廠擴建、精密製程設備和封裝測試設施相關，但統計不提供個別設備買主、驗收進度或終端產品出貨。
text.en: Semiconductor equipment imports relate to fab expansion and process/test tooling but do not identify buyers, tool acceptance or downstream shipments.

text.zh: 主計總處明列第三季 GDP 年增 14.36%，季調折年率 13.48%，兩者比較方式不同；14.36% 為概估值。中央社另引述投資與存貨變動實質年增 26.36%，這些是宏觀統計，不能與公司單季營收直接比較。
text.en: DGBAS reports 14.36% YoY GDP growth and 13.48% seasonally adjusted annualized quarter-on-quarter growth, which use different bases. CNA also cites 26.36% real growth in investment plus inventory changes; these macro measures are not company revenue.

text.zh: 半導體設備進口來源與客戶、個別廠區裝機、設備驗收及對產能實際貢獻未於本次概估中公布。
text.en: Importer identity, plant-level commissioning, acceptance and contributions to actual capacity were not disclosed.

question.zh: 32 架是否都已交付且驗出違規晶片？
question.en: Were all 32 drones delivered and found noncompliant?

text.zh: 沒有。清查範圍包含 2025 年兩機關各購 1 架，以及 2026 年移民署尚未交貨的 30 架；採購盤點不是檢驗結果。
text.en: No. The count includes two previous purchases and 30 undelivered contracted drones; the procurement tally is not a finding of component noncompliance.

question.zh: 275 萬元是完成付款的採購支出嗎？

text.zh: 官方證實的是公開招標決標的契約總額，且 30 架尚未交貨；沒有公布款項已全數支付。
text.en: The official figure is an awarded contract value for 30 undelivered drones; full payment was not reported.

question.zh: 晶片違規與責任認定目前進度為何？
question.en: What has been established about chip provenance and responsibility?

text.zh: 內政部已啟動行政清查；中央社另引述檢方正在調查涉嫌使用中國製晶片的情況。最終產地、違約及司法責任尚待確認。
text.en: The ministry initiated administrative review, and CNA reported a criminal investigation. Final chip provenance, contractual breach and legal liability remain undetermined.

title.zh: 10 月 31 日股市評論及舊法說重述
title.en: October 31 market commentary and recycled earnings

text.zh: 10 月 31 日對台積電 ADR 的股價評論，以及聯發科 10 月 30 日法說的隔日重述，均未提供新的營運執行日期或產品交付證據，因此未作為新新聞重刊。
text.en: TSMC ADR commentary and October 31 re-reporting of MediaTek's October 30 briefing did not establish new operational milestones, so were excluded.

verificationNote.zh: 無人機案 30 架仍未交貨，晶片來源及責任未獲最終認定。聯發科 2027 年約 20% ASIC 市占為預測，並非 10 月 31 日新出貨；第三季 GDP 為概估值，設備進口統計不代表機台完成驗收。
verificationNote.en: Thirty drone contract units remain undelivered and liability is unconfirmed. MediaTek's 2027 20% ASIC market share is a forecast, not new October 31 shipments. Q3 GDP is an advance estimate; tool imports do not establish qualified installations.
